tenderSchedule.title: Providing Of Man Power for Data Entry Computer Operators for HDMC for the Year of 2026-27
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Of Man Power for Data Entry / Computer Operators for HDMC for the Year of 2026-27

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Executive Engneer (IT) HDMC, Shiddappa Kambali Road, Hubli

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and condtion as per tender documents

The bidder shall mandatorily submit that affidivate on 100rs E-bond that their agency not have been declared as ineligible under corruption and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka / Government of India / Government Institutions etc., or blacklisted. Affidavit should be in the form bond paper with attested by the notary

The eligible bidders whose bid is determined to be substantially responsive shall be considered to be qualified in the technical evaluation, unless disqualified pursuant to clause Conflict of Interest or Disqualification, and shall be informed, either in writing about the date, time and place of opening of their financial bids. The firms which could not qualify in technical evaluation will be informed about this fact

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have provided Minimum 100 No. Data entry operator/Computer operator in any one of the last three financial years to any Govt. Offices/Govt. undertaking institution/ULB etc.(2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) in single work for minimum one year duration(less than one year is rejected) (Tender should submit Past experience and satisfactory performance of similar work done Certificate issued by competent authority, not below the rank of Executive Engineer cadre) (Mandatory)
Registration certificate Labour Department under Contract Labour Act of competent Government authority
PAN and GST registration copies to be enclosed

Must submit/enclose have Registration certificate under Employees State Insurance Act (ESI ACT. And remitted at least 72.10 Lakhs rupees in last 5 years, (certified copies of year wise ESI returns details from the authority to be enclosed)

Must submit/enclose Employee Provident Fund Registration Certificate issued by the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner. And remitted at least 318.00 Lakhs rupees in last 5 years, (certified copies of year wise EPF returns details from the authority to be enclosed)

Bidder shall provide Valid (in operation) local office address, rent agreement within Dharwad district submit the documents related to office address, agreement to communicate and supervising of the deployed staff or any correspondence with the officials. Details to be enclosed

The Agency should have annual turnover of last 5 years at least Rs. 6.82 crores during any two financial years. The Agencies should submit proof of Audited Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Accounts, Income and Expenditure Accounts if required

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bankers certificate unconditional overdraft/credit facilities to the extent of Rs 120.79 Lakhs (As per Schedule 7)
